q: What is one observation in a sampling distribution of means?
options: One mean calculated from an entire sample
why: Each repeated sample contributes a statistic. Individual records belong to the data distribution.

q: The register sample is drawn without replacement. Which discrepancy-count model is exact?
options: Hypergeometric for a fixed sample size
why: Finite-population sampling without replacement gives a hypergeometric count. A binomial model assumes independent trials.

q: What can increasing the number of targeted audits do?
options: Reduce variability within the selected group
why: Precision and selection bias are distinct. More high-priority cases need not reveal excluded cases.

q: For a mean based on independent observations with unknown σ, what is the estimated SE?
why: s describes individual variability; s/√n estimates the variability of the sample mean.

why: A null reference distribution uses variability under the hypothesised proportion.
